description: With no filters: every route and screen with its count, error rate, p50, p95 and slowest dependency. With any filter: matching spans from the backend and the app, or count, avg, p50, p95 and errors with group_by. Use it to find what is slow or failing, then open one with get_trace. Spans are kept 14 days.

group_by.description: Counts and timings per value instead of spans

op.description: Like http.server, http.client, ui.load, app.start, gen_ai, mcp.server

q.description: Text in the span name, any case

status.description: ok, error, or one HTTP status like 503

to.description: An ISO time, or how long ago

name: search_traces
title: Search spans and slow routes
